about_the_game:
Bloody Ink - The Hour Of Fear (Demo) is a first-person psychological horror game that aims to instill anxiety, anguish, and terror. Explore part of the house available in Bloody Ink through the eyes of Frederick.

PLOT: Frederick is a medical student who has agreed to take care of a man who is completely burned. Alone in the house, he will have to take care of the man for a few days.

In this demo, you can experience some gameplay mechanics such as:
  • 🔦 Searching for key items.
  • 🔦 Jump scares.
  • 🔦 Real-time lighting.
  • 🔦 Puzzles.
  • 🔦 Madness and interaction with the microphone.

Enjoy this mini experience. The demo content is exclusive, and you won't find it in the full game. You can play without getting spoiled and without having to repeat the same things in the complete game.

content_descriptors.notes: Some female characters may reveal partial nudity. Scenes of violence are not explicit.
